title: The Tow Truck with the Tilting Bed
synopsis: Aunt Jo has a flat tire on her yellow work van; a flatbed tow truck carries the van to the red-door garage, where the children meet Ms. Pam.
continuity_state: Before: Pine Park and Little Bridge are finished, the hay harvest is stored, and no red-door garage has been introduced. Aunt Jo drives a small yellow work van for her crew. After: The red-door garage is established on the west end of Brook Road near the northbound farm-road junction. Ms. Pam, an adult raccoon mechanic, owns a white flatbed tow truck and a garage. Her tow truck brings Aunt Jo's yellow work van, whose tire has gone flat, from a wide farm-road pull-off to the garage. The van remains there awaiting repair.

related_resources.reason: Supports a linked vehicle-mechanic detail; no tested outcome claims for these stories.
